question: How do other Synology models using V1500B configure the logical0/1 lanes, and can they validate the proposed DS1522+ split?
conclusion: RS1221+ supplies a direct official V1500B firmware precedent for independent PCIe x1 engines on logical lanes0 and1. DS1621+, DS1821+ and DS1525+ use the same pair as one x2 engine in their factory-intended layouts.
correction_to_prior_state: The earlier investigation had not found an applicable same-CPU split example. That specific evidence gap is now closed by RS1221+; the complete DS1522 candidate and its resulting port mapping remain untested.
evidence_level: Static factory-design evidence from authenticated official packages, registered and selector-reachable board tables, OEM callback review and shipped device-tree corroboration. No donor-model live boot trace was collected.

models.other_layout: logical2 and3 are also separate x1 engines; logical4..5 and6..7 are x2; logical8..11 is x4. Seven active PCIe roots in total.

rs1221_applicability.selector_chain: CPU class0x0b -> platform0 -> mask0xff table; the table is in the OEM-published pointer list.
rs1221_applicability.factory_corroboration: Official model.dtb requires disk controllers behind01.6/01.7 and the expansion slot behind01.1, matching this seven-root path rather than the two-root alternative.
rs1221_applicability.oem_callback: No explicit replacement or merge of logical0/1 entries was found in the selected-table callback.
rs1221_applicability.clock_policy: The split roots have separate clock rows with request0xff and slot-check0. Their board-specific clock IDs are1 and3.

ds1522_candidate_difference.logical_lane_pair: The same two independent x1 engine types.
ds1522_candidate_difference.other_links: The DS1522 candidate also splits logical4/5 and keeps logical2/3 as native SATA; it is not the full RS1221 layout.
ds1522_candidate_difference.clocks_and_reset: Retain the DS1522 board definitions; RS1221 values describe different physical connections.
unknowns: Actual V1500B SMU acceptance and trained-link result for the complete DS1522 candidate.
Final device/function mapping under the DS1522 firmware policy.
Deployment and boot acceptance of the modified DS1522 image.

practical_decision: Use RS1221+ as the primary same-CPU split reference. Do not continue treating the absence of any V1500B logical0/1 split precedent as a blocker. Retain the minimal DS1522 board-specific candidate until exact mapping and boot tests justify a change.
